# Session 2026-07-10 — Context Gate Integration

## Goal

Wire Memotrix as the long-term memory backend for context-gate agent loops. Queries must stay low-latency because retrieval runs on nearly every reasoning step.

## Decisions Made

Agreed that full-file expansion is wrong for agent memory: agents have hard context budgets. Parent-chunk / neighbor-window expansion capped by max_tokens_returned is the replacement.

## Open Questions

Still undecided whether to ship bge-small-en-v1.5 or nomic-embed-text-v1.5 first. Nomic would allow raising CHUNK_SIZE without hurting embedding quality.

## Action Items

Build the eval harness before changing models. Measure Recall@5, MRR, and per-query latency as the baseline.
